hero.title: Apartments

apartments.description: Four modern apartments designed to make your stay in Baška Voda comfortable, relaxing and unforgettable.

descriptions.a5: Spacious apartment with a separate bedroom, fully equipped kitchen and balcony with a beautiful sea view. Ideal for families or smaller groups looking for comfort, privacy and a relaxing stay in Baška Voda.
descriptions.a6: Comfortable apartment designed for couples with a balcony and sea view. Perfect for guests who want a peaceful holiday, proximity to the beach and a relaxing atmosphere.
descriptions.a7: Bright and modern apartment with a balcony and sea view. Ideal for smaller families or friends who want to enjoy a pleasant holiday on the Makarska Riviera.
descriptions.a8: Comfortable apartment with a balcony and side sea view. Modern design and a peaceful atmosphere provide everything needed for a relaxing holiday in Baška Voda.
